narr: A typical summertime pattern prevailed with scattered afternoon thunderstorms across portions of southwest and south-central Georgia. There were a few reports of wind damage with the strongest storms. In addition, pockets of flash flooding were observed in Colquitt county due to very heavy rainfall in excess of 5 inches in 2 hours.
ev: A large amount of water was over Lee Lewis Road.
Several homes between JD Herndon Road and Lanier Road along Highway 33 were surrounded by water. Water entered a few residences, prompting residents to evacuate.
